title: finance-budget-1on1-prep-priya-2025-q1
content:
Meeting: 1:1 w/ CFO (Ben) - Finance / Budget planning prep
Date: 2025-02-17, 30 minutes
Objective: Quick alignment on current run-rate, key risks to Q1 forecast, and approvals needed for procurement commitments before month-end.

Agenda (proposed, 30m):
- 5m: Quick status + run-rate snapshot
- 10m: Top 3 risks & mitigation asks (hiring, infra commitments, vendor costs)
- 10m: Procurement approvals needed + recommended prioritization
- 5m: Decisions & next steps (owners + deadlines)

Current run-rate summary (latest actuals through Jan 2025):
- Monthly opex run-rate (net of one-offs): ~$1.18M / month (~$14.2M annualized).
- Variance vs plan: -7.8% (plan: $1.28M/mo). Main drivers: delayed hiring (-$120k/month), lower infra overage (+$50k saved), and G&A timing shifts.
- YTD spend (Jan): $1.21M actual vs $1.28M plan. Cash runway unchanged given Series C reserves but we need to hit Q2 cadence for Dedicated GTM investments.

Key callouts / risks to flag:
1) Hiring: Engineering hiring continues to be slower. We have ~6 offers outstanding (expect 3 acceptances in Q1). If acceptance rate drops, we will underspend vs plan (~$180k savings), but risk product velocity and Dedicated rollout timelines.
2) Infra commitments: Hardware vendor (NVIDIA reserved capacity) quote locked for Mar 2025. Cost if we approve now: $1.1M capex-style commit (3yr term) vs cloud on-demand estimated ~1.5x over 3 years. Need CFO signoff to proceed.
3) SaaS vendor uptick: Datadog / SSO / security tools trend +15% vs plan as customer telemetry increases. Forecast +$35k/month starting Mar.
4) Procurement lead times: Some procurement requires procurement + legal review (procurement ticket PR-231) and procurement SLA is 10 business days. Need to start approvals now for March invoices.

Proposed asks for Ben (CFO):
- Approve NVIDIA reserved capacity term sheet (recommend: 3yr commit) to lock unit pricing. Rationale: long-term unit cost improvement, predictable throughput for Dedicated customers. Recommended approval threshold: up to $1.2M executed without board notice; >$1.2M requires exec finance + CEO signoff.
- Approve temporary reallocation of hiring budget between Q1/Q2 to front-load two infra-facing senior SWE hires (impact +$60k/month in Q1, offset by delaying 2 other non-critical hires).
- Reclassify the following recurring spend from "variable infra" to "committed infra" in the model (for more accurate forecasting): NV-reserve, edge-network contract.

Detailed procurement list (actionable items):
- NV-RESERVE-0325: NVIDIA reserved capacity term (Vendor: NVIDIA Partner). Amount: $1.1M. Owner: Priya to finalize commercial terms w/ procurement (ETA: 2025-02-24). Approval: CFO signoff required.
- SSO-ANNUAL-2025: Okta enterprise renewal (auto-renew). Amount: $95k annual. Owner: IT (Maya) to confirm renewal window. Approval: standard procurement.
- OBS-LOG-ADD: Datadog additional ingest (Q1 spike). Estimated incremental: $42k/quarter. Owner: Observability (Ethan) to confirm metrics driving increase. Approval: notify CFO, proceed if threshold exceeded.

Questions I want answered in the 1:1:
- Ben: Are you comfortable with pushing up two infra hires from Q2 into Q1 if we offset by delaying two non-critical roles?
- Ben: Preferred threshold for infra capex signoffs before needing board notification? (current recommendation: $1.2M)
- Ben: Do you want procurement to prioritize capex vs opex tradeoffs in the model, or keep them separate for reporting?

Suggested decisions (for the meeting):
- Decision 1: Approve NV-RESERVE-0325 up to $1.2M (if Ben signs off, proceed to procurement/legal).
- Decision 2: Reallocate hiring budget to front-load infra hires (approve temporary swap).
- Decision 3: Accept Datadog overage for Q1 with a follow-up deep-dive in the weekly ops sync.

Follow-ups / Action items (if decisions approved):
- Priya: Finalize term sheet redlines with procurement/legal and send to Ben for signature (due 2025-02-24).
- Procurement (Maya): Start contract intake + legal review for NV-RESERVE-0325 (ticket PR-231) (due 2025-02-28).
- Observability (Ethan): Provide 1-pager on Datadog spike with cost drivers and retention options (due 2025-02-21).
- People Ops: Freeze two non-critical roles and confirm which ones can be delayed with hiring managers (due 2025-02-21).

Notes / supporting numbers (quick reference):
- Infra run-rate breakdown (monthly estimates):
  - Cloud on-demand: $240k/mo
  - Dedicated infra (current reserved + burst): $320k/mo
  - NV-reserve projected amortized: $85k/mo (if approved, amortized over 36 months)
  - Observability + logging: $58k/mo

- Cash runway: 18 months at current spend assuming no large one-time commits. Approving NV-reserve reduces cash balance now but reduces long-term unit cost; callout for CFO to weigh cash vs unit economics.

Misc notes / reminders to self:
- Bring the 1-pager with decision tree and 2x sensitivity scenarios (base, downside -10% revenue, upside +10%).
- Print the term-sheet highlights (payment schedule, termination clauses) before the meeting.
- If Ben wants to push decision, propose a 1-week exec review window and prepare board notice draft.

End of notes.
